head:
TO THE RIGHT HO-
NOVRABLE, DAVID, LORD OF
Scone, ONE OF HIS MAIE-
sties most Honorable Priuy Coun-
cell in this Kingdome.
tail_from: Which mercie the Lord more and more
tail:
Which mercie the Lord more and more
confirme towards you for Christs
sake. Amen.
Your L. in Christ Iesus,
William Cowper,
B. of Galloway.
